about: The docs sections in the oracle's menu order (PLAN.md File tree; ids from docs/research/02 §1). build.mjs assembles them into the one docs page, docs.html, and generates its side nav from this file: each category is a <details> in the nav, and each section a link to #<id> (build.mjs header comment, step 3). Per section: id, the section's id, which its file site/docs/sections/<id>.html puts on its hgroup's h1; title, that h1's text; description, the oracle's head description of its route; and label, its nav link as HTML, only where that is not the title.
